title: UPI pal bhar me paise kaise bhejta hai?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [excited] October me har SECOND... saadhe 9 hazaar UPI payments!
NPCI ne bank se poocha: paise hain?
Bank ne PIN check karke kaat liye.
Dost ke bank ko bola: credit karo!
[laughs] Ye reel udhaar wale dost ko bhejo!
caption:
October 2026 me UPI pe 2,547 crore payments hue... matlab har second lagbhag 9,500! 🤯

Pay dabane se "credit ho gaya" tak, beech me NPCI aur do banks ki ek chhoti si baat-cheet hoti hai: paise hain? PIN sahi? Kaato. Credit karo. Bas!

Kal kis cheez ka "kaise" jaanna hai? Comment karo 👇
